# DailyForest

> A free, open-source daily and weekly planner web application featuring time blocking, shareable multi-tenant calendars, Studio Ghibli-inspired aesthetic, and full PWA offline support.

## Key Features
- [Time Blocking](https://dailyforest.vercel.app): Visual drag-and-drop daily timeline scheduler.
- [Shareable Calendars](https://dailyforest.vercel.app): Share schedule links with real-time multi-tenant sync.
- [Offline PWA Support](https://dailyforest.vercel.app): Full service worker caching for offline planning.
- [Privacy Controls](https://dailyforest.vercel.app): Optional passcode hashing and local storage privacy locks.
- [Aesthetic Ghibli Design](https://dailyforest.vercel.app): Warm pastel theme, handwritten font, and glassmorphism.

## Developer & Source Code
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/tanyas27/weekly-tracker)
- [Technology Stack](https://github.com/tanyas27/weekly-tracker): Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Neon PostgreSQL.
